lead: Ricky Ponting is a widely followed Australian cricketer, born on 19 December 1974 in Launceston.
As of 2026, he is 51 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has represented Kolkata Knight Riders and Australia national cricket team and has been recognised with Wisden Cricketer of the Year and Officer of the Order of Australia.
This profile collects the Ricky facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Ricky Ponting — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Ricky Ponting was born on 19 December 1974 in Launceston, and holds Australian nationality.
He received his education at Brooks High School.

sections.heading: Ricky Ponting — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists cricketer and cricket coach as his occupations.

On the team sheet, Ricky has been associated with Kolkata Knight Riders, Australia national cricket team (from 1995 to 2012), Tasmania cricket team (from 1992 to 2013), Somerset County Cricket Club (from 2004 to 2004), Hobart Hurricanes (from 2011 to 2013), Mumbai Indians (from 2013 to 2013), Surrey County Cricket Club (from 2013 to 2013) and Antigua Hawksbills (from 2013 to 2013). He plays as a batter.
He has taken part in 1998 Commonwealth Games.
